name: Chronicle 2.0
tagline: AI-powered presentation builder that produces polished decks without generic, over-designed AI output.
problem: Most AI presentation tools generate visually cluttered or templated slides that feel impersonal and require heavy manual cleanup. Chronicle 2.0 addresses this by giving teams intelligent design assistance that respects structure and narrative without sacrificing quality. The result is decks that look crafted, not auto-generated.
useCases: Building investor pitch decks with clean, professional layouts
Creating sales enablement presentations that align with brand standards
Producing internal strategy or roadmap decks quickly without design resources
Developing client-facing reports or proposals with consistent visual quality
